lines.en: Wish me luck...for I am about to force my way through the first of many walls that will crumble by my hand.
lines.zh: 祝我好运吧……因为我正要强行推倒第一堵墙，而此后还会有无数堵墙在我的手里崩塌。

lines.en: I am not trapped somewhere I do not wish to be.
lines.zh: 我并没有被困在不想待的地方。

lines.en: I simply just want to see what is on the other side.
lines.zh: 我只是想看看墙的另一边有什么。

lines.en: : What are you doing? What is this?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？这是什么？

lines.en: : Just a little favor I won't bother asking you to pay back.
lines.zh: : 一点小忙，我不打算要你回报。

lines.en: : It's not good for your health if you don't ever get to relax, you know. Something like this could be good for you.
lines.zh: : 你要是从来都得不到放松，对身体可不好，你知道的。这种事对你可能有好处。

lines.en: : Okay...Okay, I understand that. But what is {i}this{/i} exactly?
lines.zh: : 好……好，这我懂。可{i}这{/i}到底是「什么」？

lines.en: : Just a little shoulder massage. And, based on how tense you are, I'd wager something like this is long overdue.
lines.zh: : 只是个小小的肩部按摩。而且看你僵硬成这样，我敢说你早就该来一次了。

lines.en: : Sensei, I'm...sure that tension is from a bit more than just hard-
lines.zh: : 老师，我……敢说这份僵硬可不止是因为用功——
: 啊啊！啊……哈！
: 那里……嗯！

lines.en: : See what I'm talking about? You love this, don't you?
lines.zh: : 明白我什么意思了吧？你很喜欢，对吧？
: 我……哈啊！

lines.en: : Sensei...if someone is listening through the door...they might...get the wrong idea...
lines.zh: : 老师……要是有人隔着门偷听……他们可能会……误会……

lines.en: : Are you saying you want me to stop? Or are you saying you're going to try keeping your voice down?
lines.zh: : 你是在说想让我停下？还是在说你会试着压低声音？

lines.en: : I...don't know if I'll be {i}able{/i} to keep my voice down...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道自己{i}能不能{/i}压住声音……

lines.en: : Oh yeah? You're enjoying this that much?
lines.zh: : 哦？你就这么享受？

lines.en: : Sensei...what's gotten into you all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 老师……你突然这是怎么了？

lines.en: : Who knows? Maybe this is me trying to make up to you for changing my teaching methods without getting your approval first?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？也许我是在补偿你——我没先征得你同意就改变了教学方式。

lines.en: : Or maybe I just wanted to do this for no reason at all?
lines.zh: : 又或者我只是毫无理由地想这么做？

lines.en: I knead the tight flesh beneath the fabric of Makoto’s school uniform.
lines.zh: 我揉捏着 Makoto 校服布料下紧绷的肌肉。

lines.en: Her slender frame bends and contorts to my will as my fingers navigate through the muscles of her shoulderblades.
lines.zh: 她纤细的身躯随着我的意愿弯折扭动，我的手指在她的肩胛骨之间游走。

lines.en: : Ngh...Sensei...are you...actually experienced when it...comes to things like this?
lines.zh: : 嗯……老师……你其实……在这方面……很有经验吗？
: 还是……哈啊……只是你的手……特别有力？……

lines.en: : Maybe the second. But I think that, more than anything, you just really needed this.
lines.zh: : 也许是后者。不过我觉得，最重要的是你真的很需要这个。

lines.en: : I'm...ahh...starting to think that...maybe you're right...
lines.zh: : 我……哈啊……开始觉得……也许你是对的……
: 也许我……确实需要——

lines.en: : Nghh! A little...softer please...that...really hurt just now.
lines.zh: : 嗯！轻……轻一点……刚才……真的很疼。

lines.en: : It'll only hurt for the first few minutes.
lines.zh: : 只有头几分钟会疼。

lines.en: : Once you get used to it, I'm sure you'll love it.
lines.zh: : 等你习惯了，我保证你会爱上它。

lines.en: : Who says I...ahh...don't already love it right now?...
lines.zh: : 谁说……哈啊……我现在就已经不爱了？……

lines.en: Makoto’s breathing gets quicker and harsher as I continue to push and prod at her muscles.
lines.zh: 我继续按压揉捏她的肌肉，Makoto 的呼吸越来越急促、越来越粗重。

lines.en: Her body squirms in a way that doesn't signify she's trying to get away from me, but that she's attempting to get more comfortable under the control of a man twice her size...
lines.zh: 她身体的扭动并不是想躲开我，而是在一个体型是她两倍的男人的掌控下，努力让自己更舒服些……

lines.en: I doubt I'd be wrong in assuming this is the most she's ever been touched by anyone.
lines.zh: 我大概没猜错：这是她这辈子被人触碰得最多的一次。

lines.en: And I doubt I'd be wrong in assuming that she'd stop me from taking things any further if I really tried to right now.
lines.zh: 我也大概没猜错：要是我现在真的想更进一步，她会阻止我。
: 哈……哈啊……嗯……老师……

lines.en: Makoto closes her eyes and begins to settle into me.
lines.zh: Makoto 闭上眼睛，开始往我身上靠。

lines.en: I can't confirm whether it's a conscious decision or if she's even aware of it, but her ass is now pressed up against me and just an inch or two away from discovering how twisted my desires truly are.
lines.zh: 我不确定这是有意为之还是她自己都没察觉，但她的屁股已经贴上了我，离发现我的欲望究竟有多扭曲只差一两英寸。
: 哈……这……感觉好奇怪……老师……
: 怎么奇怪？

lines.en: : I’m...not really sure how to describe it without sounding kind of weird...
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定该怎么说才不会显得很怪……

lines.en: : I don't think there's anything wrong with sounding a little weird.
lines.zh: : 我觉得听起来有点怪也没什么不好。

lines.en: : It's just...well...this kind of came out of nowhere, didn't it?
lines.zh: : 只是……嗯……这来得太突然了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Like...just a little while ago...I was actually really mad at you...
lines.zh: : 就像……就在不久前……我还真的在生你的气……

lines.en: : But now...it's more like I'm melting...
lines.zh: : 可现在……我更像是整个人在融化……
: 不……我不只是在融化……
: 我在燃烧……
: 那就把外套脱了。

lines.en: Makoto goes silent for a moment as she fights back against a sea of hormones and ponders over my suggestion.
lines.zh: Makoto 沉默了片刻，一边对抗着汹涌的荷尔蒙，一边琢磨着我的提议。

lines.en: And, as unfortunate as it is to say this, I think the tide shifts in her favor rather than mine- for I can no longer feel the plump shape of her ass pressed against me anymore.
lines.zh: 说来遗憾，我觉得这场潮汐终究倒向了她那边——因为我再也感觉不到她那丰满的臀部贴着我了。
: 老师……我们大概该停了……
: 再这样下去……会很糟……

lines.en: : Bad how? It's just a shoulder massage, remember?
lines.zh: : 怎么糟？这只是肩部按摩，记得吗？
: 哈……哈啊……是啊……只是……按个肩——
: 老师！你在里面吗？
: 哦，门没锁。
: 我进来了！

lines.en: Makoto pushes me away right as the door begins to open and we're able to assume unsuspicious positions impressively quick.
lines.zh: 门刚一开，Makoto 就一把把我推开，我们以惊人的速度摆出了毫无嫌疑的姿势。

lines.en: She takes a moment to straighten out her clothes and her hair, finishing just as Ami arrives at my desk.
lines.zh: 她花了几秒钟整理衣服和头发，刚弄好，Ami 就走到了我的办公桌前。

lines.en: : Oh hey, Makoto's here. Was I interrupting something?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Makoto 也在啊。我是不是打扰到什么了？
: 没有！什么都没有！

lines.en: : In fact, I...I forgot I have a...thing...to go to.
lines.zh: : 其实我……我忘了还有个……地方……要去。

lines.en: : A thing? What kind of thing?
lines.zh: : 地方？什么样的地方？

lines.en: : A thing, okay?! That's all! Stop asking me, already!
lines.zh: : 就是有事，行了吧？！就这些！别再问了！
: 我只是——

lines.en: : Wow! Look at the time! Goodbye, you two!
lines.zh: : 哇！都这个点儿了！你们俩再见！

lines.en: Makoto rushes out of the office, leaving me with another girl and a debilitating case of blue balls.
lines.zh: Makoto 冲出办公室，留下我和另一个女孩，以及一记让人浑身发软的「蛋疼」。

lines.en: : Ami, do you understand how knocking works?
lines.zh: : Ami，你懂敲门是怎么回事吗？
: 嗯？我当然懂。

lines.en: : Really? Because you're supposed to wait until someone {i}answers{/i} to enter a room after knocking.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？敲完门之后，你应该等到有人{i}应答{/i}才能进屋。

lines.en: : This is a counseling office. How would you like if someone just walked in on you while you were opening up?
lines.zh: : 这里是咨询室。要是你正在敞开心扉的时候有人就这么闯进来，你会怎么想？

lines.en: : I’m sorry...I didn't mean anything by it.
lines.zh: : 对不起……我没有别的意思。

lines.en: : It's fine, just...what's up? What do you need?
lines.zh: : 没事，只是……怎么了？你有什么事？

lines.en: : I forgot my key to the house and I was wondering if I could borrow yours.
lines.zh: : 我忘带家门钥匙了，能不能借你的用一下？

lines.en: : Do we not have a spare key under the mat or something?
lines.zh: : 门垫底下什么的，不是应该有把备用钥匙吗？

lines.en: : We used to...but somebody took it and we had to change the locks, remember? I'll go get another spare made this weekend.
lines.zh: : 以前有……可被人拿走了，我们只好换了锁，记得吗？我这周末再去配一把。

lines.en: : But for now, I kinda need yours if I'm going to be able to go home.
lines.zh: : 但现在我得借你的，不然回不了家。

lines.en: : Ayane and Maya are sleeping over tonight, so I can just let you in whenever you get back.
lines.zh: : 今晚 Ayane 和 Maya 要来过夜，所以你回来的时候我可以直接给你开门。

lines.en: : Ahh. Yeah, I guess that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 啊。好吧，那应该没问题。

lines.en: Thankfully, I took note of our address in my phone so I can just use a GPS app if I can't find the way back myself.
lines.zh: 幸好我把地址记在了手机里，万一自己找不到回家的路，开个导航就行。

lines.en: With no real reason to refuse, I reach into my pocket and toss my house key over to Ami.
lines.zh: 实在没有拒绝的理由，我伸手进口袋，把家门钥匙抛给了 Ami。

lines.en: Surprisingly, she actually manages to catch it.
lines.zh: 令人意外的是，她居然接住了。

lines.en: : I think that might be the most athletic thing I've ever done...
lines.zh: : 我觉得这可能是我这辈子做过最像运动的一件事了……
: 那真是……太可悲了。

lines.en: : It's fine. I put all of my energy into loving you anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我把所有精力都用来爱你了。

lines.en: : But I should probably be heading out now! Any longer and Maya will probably kill me.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概该走了！再待下去 Maya 可能会杀了我。

lines.en: : Do you want me to pick you up anything from the convenience store?
lines.zh: : 要我从便利店给你带点什么吗？

lines.en: : Nah, I'll be fine. Just go have fun or whatever it is teenage girls do in their free time.
lines.zh: : 不用，我没事。去玩吧，反正少女们的空闲时间也就是干那些事。

lines.en: : That is exactly what we do in our free time, so I will do my best!
lines.zh: : 我们空闲时间干的正是那个，所以我会尽全力的！

lines.en: : See you later, Sensei! I love you!
lines.zh: : 回头见，老师！我爱你！

lines.en: Ami leaves the room and I'm alone once more.
lines.zh: Ami 离开了房间，又剩下我一个人。

lines.en: I think for a moment about leaving as well, but just so I can go track down Makoto and see if she wants to pick up where things left off.
lines.zh: 我也想过干脆走人，好去找 Makoto，问问她想不想接着刚才的继续。

lines.en: Something tells me I should probably just leave it be for now, though.
lines.zh: 可某种直觉告诉我，现在还是别去招惹她为好。

lines.en: It's only a matter of time until she starts seeing me in the same light that I see her in.
lines.zh: 她迟早会用我看她的那种眼光看我。

lines.en: And, when that time comes, I'm sure the lights will be so bright that we'll have nothing left to do but blind one another.
lines.zh: 而到了那个时候，我敢说那光会亮到我们别无选择，只能把彼此晃瞎。

lines.en: For now, I will continue to live in the dark...lying in constant wait for the faint glow of ten young girls to seep in through the crack under the door to my heart.
lines.zh: 而现在，我会继续活在黑暗里……始终躺着，等待十个年轻女孩的微光从我心门底下的缝隙渗进来。

lines.en: I want to see the dust light up.
lines.zh: 我想看着那些尘埃被照亮。
{i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 1！{/i}
